brief.function: Cassandra with citations: the one board member who read the charter literally. Principled, never a villain.
brief.pitch: a cool alto, median ~150-175 Hz, even (7-11 st per line), kept well below RIMA (198 Hz) so the two never blur in the sc 27 exchange
brief.pace: 150-165 wpm, precise and efficient; a clean full stop before the footnote
brief.texture: clean and articulate, crisp consonants (a footnote band at 4.5 kHz), dry
brief.attitude: polite, exact, patient; she is asking the correct question in the wrong room
brief.cadence: even statements that land on the last noun; questions lift only a little (she already knows the answer)
brief.avoid: any accent or national-origin colour; villainy, sneer or scolding; breathiness

brief.function: the poker face: runs a Q&A empire and never gives an answer. 'Good question.' is all he says.
brief.pitch: a neutral mid-baritone, median ~118-132 Hz (above MAS's 111 so the calm-off reads as two men), very narrow (<= 5 st)
brief.pace: unhurried; the two words take ~0.8-1.0 s. Pauses stand in for sentences
brief.texture: muted grey: no chest warmth, presence pulled back, dynamics held flat (3:1)
brief.attitude: courteous non-answer; not smug, not robotic, not sinister
brief.cadence: level through 'Good', a small settle on 'question'; identical every time (it is a canned answer)
brief.avoid: a synthetic/robot sheen (he is human); a sneer; any imitation

brief.function: the fire marshal of imploding boards: calm, capable, faintly bored by catastrophe.
brief.pitch: a tall baritone, median ~95-115 Hz, moderate range (8-12 st)
brief.pace: brisk, 165-185 wpm; procedural questions, no drama
brief.texture: crisp and clean: a little chest, a clean low-mid, a 2 kHz edge
brief.attitude: reassuring and practical; he has done this before
brief.cadence: short procedural questions with a quick lift; the realisation '...Ah.' falls flat and short
brief.avoid: heroics, barking, a drill-sergeant read; any imitation

brief.function: the zen landlord: he never fights, he owns the building the fight is in. Serenity is leverage; only Mas is calmer.
brief.pitch: a warm light baritone-tenor, median ~130-150 Hz (a clear lane above MAS and below GERG's bright 135 is impossible, so separation comes from pace and warmth: he is half GERG's speed), gentle range (7-11 st)
brief.pace: 125-140 wpm, measured, business words said like mindfulness mantras
brief.texture: warm, soft-onset, smiling (a small air lift), no edge
brief.attitude: warm, gently amused, delighted; generous and three moves ahead
brief.cadence: parallel phrases with even spacing ('below them, above them, around them'), each landing softly
brief.avoid: ANY accent or accent colour (explicit guardrail); 'sipping tea'; smugness; any imitation of the real voice

brief.function: the 72-hour CEO: a livestream co-founder who ran the company for a weekend and talks to 'chat' the whole time.
brief.pitch: a light, youthful-sounding mid register, median ~135-165 Hz, lively (10-14 st)
brief.pace: 155-175 wpm, casual streamer patter; the second 'Chat...' slows as he watches the sand
brief.texture: a headset mic: bass rolled off, forward presence, quick compression; dry
brief.attitude: affable, a little bemused, sincere (his exit 'deeply pleased' is played straight)
brief.cadence: addresses chat first, then the news; a small honest question lift at the end
brief.avoid: gamer-bro caricature, shouting, sarcasm; any imitation

brief.function: the adult in the other room: translates Mario's 40,000 words into three bullets and a revenue chart.
brief.pitch: a warm mezzo, median ~175-215 Hz, moderate range
brief.pace: brisk but unhurried, 150-165 wpm; the colon in 'In plain English:' is a real beat (~0.35 s)
brief.texture: warm, close and dry; a phone-call brightness is left to the mix
brief.attitude: brisk and warm; kind finality. No is a complete sentence
brief.cadence: set-up phrase level, beat, the verdict falls short and clean
brief.avoid: sibling or family framing (guardrail); coldness; sarcasm; any imitation
